experiments.scope: The blake3-r2-prefix-v1 target. Each trial executes the search of proof.md 9.1, 9.8, 9.9 and amendment N on the priced instance (flags 3, counter t by step CT) for one context and one block of 64 representatives from the seed: the work register test, the context lines, the descriptor table (packed, amendment G) and the four opened lists of N, the block test of Lemma NB (skipping a dead block), the class and opened list of Lemma NA, the straddling path, the four batches of opened representatives, opened clusters (chunk A of seven and the pending batch of amendment J, which read the mask of (1) first after a two-bit pre-test, amendments L and M), test (2) on R2 and L2, E lanes, the cached Y9 fill, T1, passing lanes with the shortcut, pre-check and preflight, the metered joint solver with (G7) and (G15) and the root predicate, and the units of proof.md Section 11 and the amendment. In the same run every member of a dead block is recomputed and checked against the window of Lemma NB and for T2 = 0, the opened list against the 64 representatives' gate values, every walked member is recomputed straight-line, closed clusters inside walked batches and left-out partners are tested bit by bit for (2) and the LW rule, batch and broadcast words against packed members, every cached Y9 against a fresh fill, every passing lane and solver call against a scalar rebuild and the ledger, every E lane's message is compressed, and every 8th trial plants a joint root that both traversals must return. The returned pair is built by steps CO and CT on the harness instance (counter 0, flags 11, the c1 forcing t = 0) for the trial's context and first passing member. No BLAKE3 library.
experiments.hypothesis: For every trial the two complete 2-round digests (counter 0, flags 11) agree on digest words 0, 2, 5 and 7, the 128 masked bits. This is exact: after the first half of round 2 the two states differ only in Y3 and Y11, and the only differing message word of the diagonal step is w5; none enters diagonals 0 and 2. The 16 observations are the program's own counts, untrusted and not recomputed by the organizer: members (walked), e_lanes (test-(2) passes), passes, solver_calls, leaves, roots, certified, units (charged machine units), solver_units (the solver ledger by nodes), opened and closed (clusters; the 64 of a dead block count as closed), skipped_pass (members of dead blocks, closed clusters or partners left out that pass (2) bit by bit), checks, mismatches (a solver call above its cap, a metered debit that differs from the ledger, a guard word, bank word, list, window or cache entry that differs counts as one), fills (batches whose packed Y9 was built) and halted. Expected per trial: one block, dead in about 44 per cent of trials; a kept block opens 26 of its 64 clusters; about 14 opened clusters, 130 walked members, 6 lanes with test (2) read, 18 filled batches, 2.2 passes and 0.6 solver calls per trial on average, almost always no root; skipped_pass, mismatches and halted 0. The counter instance cannot be digest-checked by the organizer; the run is not evidence of attack cost.
